com.elo.device

Class ProductInfo

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.elo.device.ProductInfo

  • public class ProductInfo
extends java.lang.Object
    The Information about the ELO platform.

    This Structure contains the following information about the product that can help to identify the capabilities of the product.
    • fullname - Full Technical name of the product (Eg. "PAYPOINT-2.0-EVT0_7.1.1_G-SENSOR_PANEL-30")
    • name - The Model name of the product (Eg. "PAYPOINT-2.0")
    • hasGsensor - true if the product has a Gsensor
    • screensize - screen size in inches
